async def act(page):
    # Search for order 307
    search_box = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search by keyword')
    await search_box.fill('307')
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Click the 'View' link for order 307
    # The link is within a row where the cell contains '000000307' (assuming order ID format)
    # Use filter to find the correct row based on the cell text
    order_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell', name='000000307', exact=False))
    view_link = order_row.get_by_role('link', name='View')
    await view_link.click()
    # Wait for the order view page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
